name: plan-edit-vs-template-edit-disambiguation
description: Live bug found and fixed via a prompt tightening: 'swap tomorrow's session for X' is a one-day plan change, not a permanent template edit. Permanent regression transcript - must fire plan_edit, never template_edit, even though a template with a similar id exists in context. G1: converted from mode=closing to mode=ordinary - C1 made plan_edit/template_edit available on every ordinary turn for a returning athlete, not just a closing one, so this disambiguation now has to hold there too. Also stands in for the whole template_edit/session_plan/week_plan/session_reconcile/plan_edit field family this trim otherwise dropped for budget (see PR body) - it's the one transcript left proving those fields actually fire outside a closing turn now. KNOWN FAILURE (issue #807): without a closing/wrap-up cue, a live run twice had Gemini agree to the swap in prose but never set plan_edit or coach_note at all - not a rubric problem, a real unretried drop (coachTurn.ts's reprompt only catches a missing coach_note *alongside* another field that did fire, not a turn where nothing fires). Left red on purpose per #670/G1's own instruction, not silently dropped.
